experiment: Layer-pooled Hessian shrinkage for low-budget MoE GPTQ (feasibility MVP)

calibration.prefixes: chronological S16 c S32 c S64 c S128 of the frozen order

layers_note: exploratory, outcome-informed choice from earlier AGQ studies; not sampled

experts.rule: per layer: ascending sort of B32 routed-token count (ties -> lower expert id); low = ranks {0,1}, median = ranks {29,30}, high = ranks {58,59}. Exposure only: no covariance, AGQ or reconstruction information was inspected.

estimators.pooled: H = n_e[(1-a) Hbar_e + a P_e], P_e = Hbar_L tr(Hbar_e)/tr(Hbar_L) (trace-matched)
estimators.identity: H = n_e[(1-a) Hbar_e + a tr(Hbar_e)/d I] (trace-matched control)
estimators.untraced: H = n_e[(1-a) Hbar_e + a Hbar_L] (covariance diagnostic only, never quantized)
estimators.pure_prior: alpha = 1 pooled prior (covariance diagnostic only, never quantized)
estimators.alpha0: raw H_e passed unchanged (no normalization round trip)
estimators.pooled_hessian: H_L = sum over every MoE-input token of the prefix (forward_pre_hook on the router gate = gate/up input), each token once
estimators.down: down_proj always uses its raw routed Hessian at the same budget

tuned_damping.source: runs_diag/damping_threshold_report.md (best percdamp per prefix, tuning split, seeds 0/1); applied to all three projections; not re-searched

tune.note: historical tuning split; disjoint from the C4 pool rows 0-1999 the FR s0 calibration set was drawn from; the ONLY split used for expert selection and the layer-wise baseline choice

confirm.note: document-disjoint confirmation split; identical windows to runs_legacy_metric_reeval; inspected in earlier studies -> not pristine

oldtest.note: historical test rows 2128-2255; inspected in many prior studies

stage1.reference: tune split ~/moe_cache rows 2000-2127: routed gu second moment Hbar_ref = H_ref/n_ref (finite-sample proxy, not population truth); never used to build the prior

rule.c3: mean D_F(pooled, a) < mean D_F(identity, a)
rule.c4: no layer whose mean D_F(pooled, a) exceeds its mean D_F(raw) by > 1 %
rule.selection: per budget, among passing nonzero alphas, the lowest mean tuning D_F; a budget with no passing alpha is NOT carried into Stage 2
rule.fail: no passing alpha at B16 and B32 -> POOL-PRIOR-NO-GAIN, stop before Stage 2

methods.D: raw H, tuned percdamp (B16 3.0, B32 2.0) on all projections
methods.E: standard GPTQ at B64 / B128 (quality references, different calibration cost)

stage2.primary_metric: J_e = sum_i c_ie^2 ||E_fp(x_i) - E_q(x_i)||^2 / (sum_i c_ie^2 ||E_fp(x_i)||^2 + eps) on the confirmation split (~/moe_cache_confirmation rows 0-255), complete expert MLP, frozen BF16 routing, fp32 math, BF16-rounded quantized weights (as installed); summary = mean over the 12 experts
secondary: E3-form projection reconstruction (gate+up+down, ratio of token sums) on confirm
fraction improved, p90 / worst expert change

criteria.c1: >= 1 % lower mean J than standard GPTQ at B16 or B32
criteria.c3: mean J_pool <= 1.005 x mean J_tuned (same budget)
criteria.c5: no expert worse than +5 % vs standard
criteria.c6: layer-mean J improves on both L8 and L16
criteria.c7: optional six-expert subset replacement does not contradict (pooled <= standard)
criteria.c9: measured pooled-accumulation time <= 5 % of (replay + 60-expert GPTQ) per layer
criteria.note: c1-c6 must hold at the same budget

stage2.verdict_precedence: BLOCKED > POOL-PRIOR-NO-GAIN (Stage 1) > PROMISING > REGULARIZATION-ONLY > MISMATCH-ONLY > NO-GAIN (moe_calib.hessian_shrinkage.classify)
stage2.gap_recovery: R = (E_B^std - E_B^pool)/(E_B^std - E_2B^std), reported only when the gap > 1 % of E_B^std
stage2.subset: optional: only if Stage 2 improves J; L8/L16 all 60 experts standard GPTQ at the budget vs the same with the 6 selected experts' gate/up replaced by pooled weights; exact MoE output on confirm

precision: BF16 model forward; Hessian accumulation fp32; mixing fp64 cast to fp32; evaluation fp32
